summary: DimensionCompiler translates Dimension metadata into backend-agnostic mountainash expression templates for filter evaluation.

key_classes.name: DimensionCompiler
key_classes.summary: Compiles each MatchStrategy to a mountainash expression. Used by ExpressionRulesEngine and exported for advanced users providing dimension_expressions directly.

extension_points: Adding a new MatchStrategy: add a case to compile_dimension() and a _compile_<strategy> method.
The _compile_string_match shared wrapper handles sentinel-aware ternary encoding for string ops.
lifecycle_notes: REGEX: uses a literal pattern from Dimension.regex_pattern, not per-row. Produces no unknown state.
SET_MEMBERSHIP / SET_EXCLUSION: use t_is_in / t_is_not_in from mountainash; list-column support is pending upstream.
documentation_hooks: The _compile_string_match sentinel-to-0 contract is the key invariant for string strategies.
Extension guide should show _compile_exact as the minimal example to follow.
risks: SET_MEMBERSHIP / SET_EXCLUSION use a Polars-native workaround — cross-backend parity not guaranteed.
open_questions: Once mountainash t_is_in/t_is_not_in supports list-column references natively, the SET_MEMBERSHIP workaround can be removed.

evidence.detail: compile_dimension match statement covers all 11 MatchStrategy values
